system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I need some help with my recent orders. I just got into gaming but realized I need to focus more on studying, so I want to cancel or return everything I bought that's not related to gaming. Can you help me with that? Also, I prefer to get my refund through PayPal if possible.

I can help — first I need to verify your account so I can pull your orders. Please provide either:

- the email on your account (fastest), or  
- your first name, last name, and ZIP code.

A few important things before I look up your orders:
- I can cancel pending orders and return delivered orders. I’ll list each order and the items I find and mark which look gaming-related so you can confirm which to cancel/return.
- I must get your explicit confirmation (yes) before I make any cancellations/returns or other changes.
- Refunds must go to the original payment method or to an existing gift card. If an order was originally paid with PayPal, I can refund to PayPal; if not, PayPal refund isn’t possible. Is that acceptable?
- Do you want me to automatically classify “gaming-related” items for you (I’ll flag likely gaming items), or would you prefer to review and tell me which items are non-gaming?

Once you give me the account info (email or name+ZIP) and confirm the refund note and how you want items classified, I’ll look up your orders and list the actions to confirm.

Sure, my email is mia.garcia2723@example.com.

About the refund, I get it—if PayPal isn’t possible for some orders, then just let me know which ones can go to PayPal and which can’t. That’s fine, I guess.

For the items, can you please just flag what you think is gaming-related and I’ll confirm? I really want to return or cancel everything else. 

Let’s get started, please.

arguments.summary: Customer Mia Garcia (email mia.garcia2723@example.com) requests cancelling pending orders and returning delivered orders for everything not gaming-related. Please assist and authenticate customer, list orders, flag gaming items, and obtain explicit confirmations before proceeding with cancellations/returns and refund routing.

messages.content:
Thanks — I’m ready to help, but I ran into an internal error when trying to look up your account using the email you provided. I can’t access your orders until I authenticate your account.

Would you like me to:
- Try the email lookup again right now, or
- Provide your first name, last name, and ZIP code instead so I can try that, or
- Have me escalate to a human agent to finish this (I’ll attempt to transfer; if that fails I’ll tell you next steps)?

Quick confirmations while we sort the lookup:
- You want me to flag likely gaming-related items and you’ll confirm which ones to cancel/return — correct?
- You prefer refunds to go to PayPal when possible; if an order can’t be refunded to PayPal I should tell you which original payment method will be used — correct?

Tell me which option you want (retry email lookup, give name+ZIP, or escalate), and confirm the two quick items above, and I’ll proceed.

Ugh, this is really frustrating. Can you just escalate me to a human agent? I don’t want to waste more time with errors.

And yes, you got it right—I want you to flag what you think is gaming-related and I’ll confirm, and I want PayPal refunds whenever possible. If not, just tell me how the refund will work.

Please get me to a real person who can actually help.
